descriptor.scene: A WARM PRIVATE DINING ROOM SET FOR INTRODUCTIONS, and DAVID KOBROSKY stands at the head of a long wooden table gesturing two small founder teams toward each other, one team seated on each side. On the LEFT, two founders half-risen from their chairs; on the RIGHT, two more leaning across with hands extended toward their counterparts; ALL FOUR founders' EYES ARE ON EACH OTHER across the table, faces lighting with recognition, while DAVID'S EYES move between them, delighted. In front of each team sits an open SUPERCHARGED LAPTOP glowing coral, each SCREEN FACING ITS OWN TEAM. Two small coral holographic SUB-AGENTS in glowing white sailor caps carry a bread basket and a carafe down the table like tiny waiters. Warm pendant light, wine glasses, notebooks. It reads as a dinner, never a boardroom. Lower-right: table wood and one folded napkin, calm.
descriptor._caption: At Anthropic his introductions found a new scale. Two companies building on Claude, solving cousin problems in different cities, ought to be comparing notes. They had never met. Now they meet, because David noticed. Builders, meet builders. Let me introduce you.
descriptor.anonymous: Four founders, two per team, all visibly distinct from David and from each other: a tall Black woman in a rust blazer and a wiry white man with glasses on the left; an East Asian woman with a silver bob and a bearded Latino man in a henley on the right. Nobody wears sky-blue; nobody resembles David.
